balanced_ordering.optimization_status: heuristic balanced annealing; not a proof of optimality

boundary: Foundry-specific feasibility audit using public PDK/platform figures and explicit design assumptions; no GDS, DRC, S-parameter simulation, or fabricated chip.
hard_blockers: The standard public SOI340 basic-cell list exposes MMI, MZI, heater, bend and waveguide cells but no platform-certified crossing with measured S-parameters.
Spatial path encoding requires 480 selector/recombiner MMIs, not six total couplers.
Six selector-phase planes require 480 optical phase shifters unless a common-mode phase technology is introduced.
Independent calibration exceeds the referenced 120-DC packaging capacity.
Conservative strip propagation plus five signal uses is incompatible with a low-loss single-photon architecture.
platform: CORNERSTONE 340 nm SOI, 1550 nm TE strip
verdict: Logical routing is exact, but the naive spatial CORNERSTONE SOI340 implementation is not tapeout-ready. A low-loss SiN passive layer plus active phase layer, or time/frequency serialization, is required.
